value.rationale: Sharp endpoint conditioning of Dirichlet-weighted affine least-squares fits is motivated by positive-data overshoot and high-dimensional simplex approximation. Distinct n-alpha regimes separate bounded instability under finite total prior mass from linear growth under fixed per-coordinate concentration.
